This looks like an arugula salad with a few golden raisins and possibly a light dressing, on a square plate roughly 26 cm across. The greens cover only a small part of the plate. A loose pile of arugula that size is probably about 40 g. The raisins and dressing add a little more, so I estimate about 50 g of food in total.

Arugula has very few calories, about 25 kcal per 100 g, so 40 g is roughly 10 kcal. A few raisins add about 15 kcal, and a light coating of oil dressing adds about 40 kcal. That brings the total to roughly 65 kcal.
